acceptance_criteria.criterion: docs/agents/project-manifest/testing.md contains a table row for composer seed-tests with a description such as 'Seed system users into the test database' and an example invocation.
The documentation explains that running tests requires a pre-seeded test database and that missing system users will produce a BootException directing the developer to run composer seed-tests.
The documentation mentions that TestSuiteBootstrap registers a shutdown handler to roll back orphaned transactions, preventing InnoDB lock wait timeouts from crashed test processes.
All additions follow the existing documentation style and Markdown formatting conventions in the file.

summary: Added `composer seed-tests` row to the Composer Scripts table in the Running Tests section.

Added a 'Seeding the Test Database' subsection under Local Test Environment Setup: explains the seeding requirement, the `composer seed-tests` command, what TestSuiteBootstrap::seedSystemUsers() does, the BootException (error code 175001) that fires when system users are missing, and that seeding is a one-time operation per DB instance.

Added a 'Transaction Shutdown Handler' subsection under Bootstrap Process: documents that TestSuiteBootstrap registers a PHP shutdown function via registerTransactionCleanupHandler() that calls DBHelper::rollbackConditional() to roll back orphaned transactions, explains why this prevents InnoDB lock wait timeouts from crashed test processes, and confirms that rollbackConditional() is a no-op when no transaction is active.
